title: agentOS: 254× cheaper sandbox alternative, powered by WebAssembly | Product Hunt
excerpt: Give agents a Linux operating system as a library – no sandboxes, VMs, or SaaS. Built on WebAssembly, the same tech powering Cloudflare Workers and Chrome. Support Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Eve, and Flue.
